items.corrections: The bounded search found no readable evidence for an energy-free, universal molecular separation platform. The impact forecast is unsupported in the inspected material.
Opened review establishes the challenge of early inherently safer design and safety quantification; no primary rule makes all chemistries physically incapable of runaway.

The source search describes ongoing scale-up limitations and models that still require calibration; no general theory for all systems was found. The impact forecast is unsupported in the inspected material.
Opened CO2 electroreduction roadmap supports product-selectivity and stability research challenges; no inspected primary result meets the multi-feedstock, all-product >90% claim.
Opened case-study review reports bounded heat-pump integration performance with COP 2.2–5.8; universal 100% recovery without capital/utilities and industry-wide 40–60% forecast remain unsupported.
Actual preprint title corrected. Simulator-checked blueprint generation is background to autonomous operations, not a result demonstrating continuous plant control, reconfiguration or safety.
No opened page established a universal fully recyclable designer-solvent class. The impact forecast is unsupported in the inspected material.
No retrieved primary page substantiates the original reaction-separation-heat device claim; corrected unsupported component previously marked partial-progress with empty sources.
No opened source substantiated a predictive closed-loop framework for circular manufacturing of all chemicals. The impact forecast is unsupported in the inspected material.
Company-authored poster provides bounded bioreactor design-space modeling and CHO scale-transfer example; no universal organism/1-to-million-liter gradient-free platform is shown.
